Approve corrected M2.03 candidate b4f3ccdf929de5aeb3f0dcbb1bafab547fcb804f. No remaining blocking findings in the reviewed M2 scope. I reviewed the implementation and the mathematical expectations and code of independently authored oracles; I inspected retained execution receipts and did not execute these builds.

The prior coordinate-variance defect is repaired: CrossClosure[L,R] is Lin[Primal[R],Dual[L]], first-order contrasts are Lin[Primal[E],Primal[C]], and all intermediate boundaries compose through public Lin.andThen. QueryEvaluation is removed. Scalar evaluation traces an endomorphism of Dual[ER] in width-one batches. Tests reject same-axis Table closures, dual forms and old contrast witnesses, admit public primal forms through actual query evaluation, and retain signed rectangular, reversal, actual-adjoint, replay-refusal, lazy-access and scale-aware independent numerical checks.

Verified clean canonical HEAD b4f3ccdf929de5aeb3f0dcbb1bafab547fcb804f and exact M2 blob parity with mixed 6e8aacdbcea18b4b75bd1058f3747815d8b75b9b: Queries.scala 933223314f9138bd7d030f553d4192e6f2680adb; QueryOracleSuite.scala be5b2ee11d462d8c72f1b4ee5d09d8e10c624f60; verification document 6e2fee41e24690d715fbd16958acec809cd737ec.

Full logs were scanned, byte lengths match metadata, and neither has any warn/error lines.
